scope: Source discovery and selection methodology; not an approved species list
notes: Counts below are publisher-reported and have not been merged or taxonomically deduplicated.
Publicly readable does not establish permission to redistribute documents or train on their photographs.
Source presence, planting recommendation, actual application and measured commonness are distinct evidence types.
Browser reading and direct-download access differ. Direct HTTP/TLS results and hashes recorded; failed links never treated as parsed tables.
